title: 首届 FreeBSDCon 的商业承办方
issue: 首届会议为 1999 年伯克利 FreeBSD Conference。公司史页（FreeBSD Mall，即 Walnut Creek CDROM）逐字：“In 1999 we sponsored the first FreeBSD Conference, in Berkeley, California. It was attended by over 325 people, and 18 exhibitors, which was the maximum the conference center could accommodate.”；同页另载 “Pat organized and ran the first two BSD Conferences”（Pat Rietz 时任公司副总裁）——出资与承办均在发行商一侧、先于学会与用户团体，题面成立。注：题面未写年份，正文宜补 1999。

title: BSDCon 系与 USENIX 的接手
issue: USENIX 官方 CFP（BSDCon 2002）逐字：“This is the third BSDCon, but the first to be sponsored by the USENIX Association.”；公司史页逐字：“In 2000 we sponsored BSDCon-2000 in Monterey, California. BSDCon is now an annual event, sponsored by Usenix.”——“第三届起改由 USENIX”之计数把 FreeBSDCon ’99 与 BSDCon 2000 计入系列，与 USENIX“third BSDCon”及 Walnut Creek“the first two BSD Conferences”两处互证，办会主体由发行商转学会坐实。

title: 程序委员会的跨机构构成
issue: BSDCon 2002 程序委员会实测：主席 Sam Leffler（Errno Consulting），委员 “Jun-ichiro itojun Hagino, IIJ Research Laboratory/KAME Project” 与 “Chris G. Demetriou, Broadcom Corp.”“Jordan K. Hubbard, Apple Computer, Inc.”“Perry E. Metzger, Wasabi Systems, Inc.”“Jim Mock, Consultant”“Gregory Neil Shapiro, Sendmail, Inc.” 并列——厂商、研究机构与独立顾问混编、KAME 项目在列，逐字坐实。

title: 会议选址与场地容量
issue: 三届会址逐字坐实：伯克利（“the first FreeBSD Conference, in Berkeley, California”）、蒙特雷（“BSDCon-2000 in Monterey, California”）、旧金山（“February 11-14, 2002 Cathedral Hill Hotel, San Francisco, California, USA”）；容量与展位约束逐字：“18 exhibitors, which was the maximum the conference center could accommodate”。

title: 教程日与论文日的分工
issue: USENIX BSDCon 2002 CFP 逐字：“Two days of tutorials will precede two days of technical sessions and a vendor exhibit.”——两日教程在前、两日论文与厂商展在后，与题面全同。

title: 首届欧洲年会的命名与地点
issue: EuroBSDCon 官方史页（2024 站）逐字：“The inaugural conference (EuroBSDCon) was organized in 2001, November 9th till 11th, under the name BSDCon Europe 2001. It was held at the Thistle Hotel in Brighton (UK).”——首届以 BSDCon Europe 之名办于布莱顿、EuroBSDCon 品牌后起，坐实。

title: 轮值城市与东西欧交替
issue: FreeBSD Journal 2016《EuroBSDcon: Behind the Scenes》逐字：“hosted in a different European city every year”“the board looks for a city the conference has not been held in before so that frequent attendees have a chance to visit different places”“It also tries to alternate between destinations in Western and Eastern Europe for the same reasons.”——每年换城、董事会避旧城、东西欧轮替、理由为常客换城，四点逐字在案。

title: 基金会与组织委员会的分权
issue: 同文逐字：“in 2010 a nonprofit foundation was created to back the organizers, both financially and organizationally. The EuroBSDcon Foundation is based in the Netherlands.”“the responsibilities for the conference organization are divided into three parts”“The foundation provides a legal entity to sign contracts and to ensure the financial security of the organizers…advances for venues and hotels can be paid.”——2010 年荷兰基金会、签约与垫资、职责三分、组织委员会逐年更换且司本地会务，全坐实。

title: 四天会期与并行议程
issue: 同文逐字：“lasts four days: the first two days are tutorial and devsummit days, and the final two days are the conference itself with two to three parallel tracks.”——四天会期、前两日教程与开发者峰会、后两日会议、两到三条并行议程，逐字对应。

title: 赞助占比与注册费结构
issue: 同文逐字：“about a third of the conference budget is provided by them. The other two thirds of the budget comes from the entrance fees.”——约三分之一赞助、三分之二注册费，坐实；同文另载基金会承诺公布资产负债表与损益表。

title: 创办者纪念与差旅资助
issue: 同文逐字：“In memory of its first chairman and one of its founders, the EuroBSDcon Foundation offers the Paul Schenkeveld travel grant.”；基金会资助页逐字：“he established the EuroBSDCon Foundation in 2010 to ensure continuity for many more conferences.”——以首任主席 Paul Schenkeveld 命名的差旅资助为常设（2021 届曾把 2020 年获奖者顺延、2026 届仍在征件），坐实。

title: 台北首会与东京续办
issue: 2003 年公告逐字：“the USENIX AsiaBSDCon 2004 will take place at Academia Sinica, Taipei, Taiwan between March 13 2004 and March 15 2004.”；2007 年站逐字：“The next conference will be held in Tokyo, in March of 2007.”；BSD Taiwan 专访逐字：“後來 05、06 沒有辦；到了 07 年，歐洲美洲社群鼓勵日本的 Developer Hiroki Sato…繼續舉辦，於是第二屆 AsiaBSDCon 便於東京舉行”——由日本组织者在东京续办坐实（2011 年站 General Chair 亦为 Hiroki Sato）。辨析：ja.wikipedia 列“AsiaBSDCon 2006 東京”，与基金会 2006-12-23 快报“It’s been two years since the last BSD conference in Asia”及专访“05、06 沒有辦”相悖，维基仅线索、不采。

title: 固定会址的取舍与代价
issue: BSD Taiwan 专访逐字：“直到 2023 年為止，AsiaBSDCon 都是辦在東京，期間只有因為疫情斷三年”“其實好幾年前，社群就有討論要換個國家舉辦 AsiaBSDCon，但要在新的地方從頭開始，難度還是頗高”；2011 年站逐字：“The next conference will be held in Tokyo, in 17-20 March, 2011.”——东京长期固定与换国从零筹办之难，坐实。

title: 双语教程与论文议程
issue: FreeBSD Foundation 2012-04-09 报告（AsiaBSDCon General Chair Hiroki Sato 提供）逐字：“There were 8 tutorials (6 in English and 2 in Japanese) and the number of students were 4-20 for each. The paper session had 11 papers and 1 keynote. The number of attendees was 105.”——英日两轨教程、11 篇论文另设 1 场主题演讲，逐字坐实。精度注：数字系 AsiaBSDCon 2012（第 7 届）实测，题面未注年份，正文宜补注（2007 年首届东京会议为 16 篇论文加 2 场邀请演讲，结构不同）。

title: 注册退款的事务局经办
issue: AsiaBSDCon 2011 官方站逐字：“Please contact asiabsd2011@gmt.jtb.jp and secretary@asiabsdcon.org to refund the tutorial fee (100% refund).”，注册取消同用此两邮箱（“We refund 50% of your registration fee.”）——JTB（gmt.jtb.jp 系 JTB Global Marketing & Travel）与事务局邮箱分担联络，坐实；2007 年站另载 “our travel agency” 承办观光与订房（jtbgmt.com 链接）。

title: 厂商峰会与地区产业联络
issue: 同报告逐字：“In the 2-day meeting session George Neville-Neil and I held a half-day Vendor Summit.”与 “Shozo Takeoka, myself, and others are planning to set up an organization ‘BSD-BA (BSD Business Association)’, a Japanese BSD consortium.”；该届主题演讲即 “Embedded Technology and BSD UNIX in Japan”（讲者 AXE, Inc. 创办人）——半日厂商峰会、日本嵌入式厂商入议程、向行业协会推进，坐实。

title: 大学场地与低价办会
issue: BSDCan 运营博客逐字：“One of our goals is to be inexpensive. Last year BSDCan raised its prices for the first time since 2005.”（2024-09 文，即 2023 年首次提价、此前自 2005 未涨）与选城成本考量 “That excludes the downtowns of Toronto or Vancouver.”；官方站场地逐字：“Location: University of Ottawa, in the Desmarais (DMS) building.”——渥太华大学场地与低价原则坐实。精度注：“注册费自 2005 年起长期未涨”须限定为“至 2023 年首次上调前”。

title: 创办者退出与主席轮替
issue: 官方页逐字：2025 年 “Coordinator, Chair and Whip Operator: Michael Lucas”，2026 年 “Conference Chair: Patrick McEvoy”；运营博客逐字：“For BSDCan 2024, we are migrating from a ‘Dan Langille does everything’ model to a Redundant Array of Independent Dans.”与 “my goal in taking over BSDCan was to transform it into a self-sustaining team effort supported and run by the community.”——创办者个人承担转委员会共担、2025 与 2026 两届主席轮替，坐实。

title: 运营委员会的月度例会
issue: 运营博客逐字：“We meet on the last Saturday of the month at 1800 UTC, and every Saturday the month before the con.”——每月末固定例会、会前一个月改每周例会，逐字坐实。精度注：“议程按会期倒排”系对 “every Saturday the month before the con” 的解读性转述，非原文，正文宜弱化或加注。

title: 会址不迁的运营理由
issue: 同文逐字：“Moving BSDCan to a new city would require someone in that city to take point on arranging convention space and attendee housing.”“You gotta help run a BSDCan before we’ll trust you to host a BSDCan.”并开篇言明 “We’re not planning on moving”——迁址须本地负责人承接场地与住宿、无人承接即留渥太华，且门槛成文于官方运营博客（惯例），坐实。

title: 差旅报销时限与机票占比
issue: 运营博客逐字：“We intend to maintain the practice of reimbursing expenses within 30 days of the conference ending.”“Airfare is our biggest expense, and holding down costs helps us throw a better conference.”——会后三十日内报销、机票为最大支出、压低成本为原则，逐字坐实（2025 与 2026 两届公告同文重申）。

title: 北美转线上与欧洲整届取消
issue: BSDCan 2020 官方站逐字：“BSDCan 2020 will be an online conference. It will not be in person.”；EuroBSDCon 2020 官方站逐字：“EuroBSDCon 2020 is cancelled…there will be no EuroBSDCon 2020. There will be no virtual conference, as we feel we can’t provide much in that area not already provided by BSDCan.”——北美转线上、欧洲整届取消且不设线上替补、两地处置不一致，坐实（基金会 2022 会议报告亦载 “We decided to completely cancel the 2020 edition because BSDCan already went virtual”）。

title: 线上议程的平台选择
issue: FreeBSD Journal 2022 会议报告（EuroBSDCon 2021 组织者 René Ladan 问答）逐字：“We settled on using BigBlueButton for the talks and Spatial.chat for the hallway track. We chose two services because BigBlueButton had more mature recording capabilities at the time and an API that we could use to schedule the recordings, while Spatial.chat provided a real nice online hallway experience.”——报告与走廊各用一套服务、按录制能力与随机交谈之需选型，逐字坐实。

title: 海外参会者的线上照顾
issue: 同报告逐字：“we had to organize an online component to cater to our overseas attendees anyway, so we figured it was easier to just keep it online.”——原拟小规模线下、因海外参会者须线上接入而保留线上环节，坐实。

title: 线上会期的互动缺失
issue: 同报告逐字：“We did feel the interaction with people was missing, giving a talk or making announcements in front of a screen just isn’t the same as with a crowd sitting in front of you.”——组织者自评最大损失在互动、屏前报告与现场不可等量，坐实。

title: 会期之外的线下小聚
issue: 同报告逐字：“We held an unofficial, in-person mini-conference in Vienna which attracted some people from the organization and some local people—so that gave us the opportunity to still socialize a bit before, during, and after the conference.”——线上会期之外另办非正式线下小聚以补社交，坐实；同刊同篇载该届线上注册约 500 人（“approximately 500 registrations”），规模悬殊成立。

title: 访谈取材与成书方法
issue: 断言“以百余位当事人访谈为底本”获独立二手支撑——中译本页自述“在撰写本书过程中，Peter Salus 采访了 100 多位 UNIX 社群的重要人物，并收集了从澳大利亚到奥地利的大量相关资料”；“成书方法接近口述史”为体例引申，无碍。建议正文引原书（Addison-Wesley 1994）英文序或封底原句加固，本条现系 B 级二手。

title: 作者的语言学出身
issue: TUHS 讣告帖（Mark Seiden，2026-05-19）逐字：“peter was not just an eminent linguist (by training, vocation and scholarship)”——语言学出身坐实，帖内并及其 1971 年圣克鲁兹夏季语言学研究所亲历。

title: 学会职务与记录者身份
issue: 同帖逐字：“but was also executive director of usenix assn for many years, so responsibile for a lot of community building.”（responsibile 系原文拼写，照录）——“长期担任 USENIX 执行董事”与组织者身份成立。

title: 亲历者视角的权威与偏向
issue: 同帖逐字：“and full of stories, which is why he wrote several books about the history of unix and the early history of the internet. (he was there and knew everybody, so the books are authoritative…)”——“亲历现场且熟识当事人，记述因熟悉而权威”获同侪一手陈述直接支撑。

title: 身后评价与史料定位
issue: 同帖 Dan Cross 逐字：“I just found out that Peter Salus passed away on May 15. His “Quarter Century of Unix” is required reading for any serious student of Unix history.”——2026 年去世（2026-05-15）与“必读”评价逐字坐实，帖首标题 “[TUHS] RIP Peter Salus”，同帖多名同侪追述，“邮件列表重估”成立。

title: 《The Complete FreeBSD》版次
issue: 作者自述页逐字：“Among my publications are Porting UNIX Software, published by O'Reilly and Associates and Installing and Running FreeBSD and its successor The Complete FreeBSD, both originally published by Walnut Creek CDROM. The fourth edition of The Complete FreeBSD was published by O'Reilly and Associates.”；履历页出版表同证（“Book Porting UNIX Software, published by O'Reilly and Associates”“Book “Installing and Running FreeBSD”, published by Walnut Creek CDROM.”）。精度注记：“两部手册”＝《Installing and Running FreeBSD》及其后继《The Complete FreeBSD》，非《Porting UNIX Software》（后者初版即 O'Reilly）——正文行文须点名两部，防读者误读。

title: 版权回归与自由发布
issue: 自述页逐字：“In agreement with O'Reilly, I released Porting UNIX Software under the Creative Commons license in October 2004, and on 24 February 2006, the 10th anniversary of the first edition, I also released The Complete FreeBSD.”——“与出版社协议后把两部书以自由许可释出”成立（两部时点 2004-10 与 2006-02-24 可并陈）。

title: 用户会主席与核心团队
issue: 自述页“In previous times I have been: The president of AUUG, the Australian UNIX User Group. A member of the FreeBSD Core team.”；履历页同证（“I am an ex-President of AUUG, the Australasian UNIX Users Group.”“I am a member of the FreeBSD developers team, and an ex-member of the FreeBSD Core team..”）——两职均为曾任。小注：AUUG 全称两页作 Australian／Australasian 并存，正文可并陈。

title: 亚洲与北美会议的内核调试教程
issue: 履历页演讲表逐字：“March 2004 | Tutorial “Debugging Kernel Problems” at the AsiaBSDCon in Taipei.”与“May 2005 | Tutorial Debugging Kernel Problems at the BSDCan conference in Ottawa.”——两地两次教程坐实。小注：同一教程 2001–2006 年在 Brighton／旧金山／悉尼／卡尔斯鲁厄等地重复开设，“分别在”系择例而非全部，正文宜言“曾于”。

title: 退休时点与出版中止
issue: 自述页逐字：“I retired from active work on 1 July 2007.”；履历页末段逐字：“Since retirement I am no longer actively publishing, but I am interested in writing on a number of topics, including debugging and further FreeBSD books.”——2007 年 7 月退休、停止活跃出版、保留写作计划三断言全坐实。

title: 独立出版与出版社双轨
issue: 作者博客（2025-06-03）逐字：“All Tilted Windmill Press titles are now available directly from me in paperback and ebook at https://tiltedwindmillpress.com.”与“Books from No Starch Press (Absolute FreeBSD, Absolute OpenBSD, and Network Flow Analysis) are not included.”——自办 Tilted Windmill Press 与商业出版社（No Starch）双轨并行坐实。

title: 书号自持与印刷渠道
issue: 作者博客（2018-07-26）逐字：“Last December, I finally purchased a block of one thousand ISBNs so that I could use non-CreateSpace printers.”与“After a few months of sales data, I'm confident in saying that adding IngramSpark has increased book sales.”——自购 ISBN 区块、接入第二家按需印刷商（IngramSpark，与 CreateSpace 并行）坐实。

title: 再版劝告与旧版处置
issue: 同文逐字：“I've openly declared, repeatedly, that if you bought the first edition and kept up on changes in SSH, you don't need to buy the second edition.”——公开劝旧版读者不必重购坐实（SSH Mastery 二版语境）；全文并见其对“为再版而再版”的批评，自我约束表述有据。

title: 选题面向系统管理员
issue: 同文列举书目逐字：“Specifically Networking for System Administrators, Tarsnap Mastery, Sudo Mastery, and DNSSEC Mastery.”——题面“备份、sudo 与 DNS”对应 Tarsnap（在线备份）／Sudo／DNSSEC 三主题之书；“读者定位为在岗管理员”与《Networking for System Administrators》书名及博客定位一致。

title: 会议主办与写作的交叉
issue: BSDCan 2024 与 2025 两年组织者页同句逐字：“Coordinator, Chair and Whip Operator: Michael Lucas”——两年任主席坐实（两页并载 “Papers Shepherd: Michael W Lucas”；Dan Langille 同列 “Auctioneer, Voice of Experience”）。

title: 周播节目的制作节奏
issue: 本人站逐字：“A weekly (previously video) podcast covering the latest news and tutorials in the BSD world.”——周更、早期视频形态、新闻与教程选材三断言坐实；bhyvecon 讲稿同证（“BSDNow.tv is a weekly video podcast featuring News, Interviews and Tutorials about the BSD family of Operating Systems.”）；bsdnow.tv/about 证周三播出节奏（“The show airs on Wednesdays at 2:00PM”）。

title: 主持期数与节目交接
issue: 本人站逐字：“I hosted the majority of the first 512 episodes.”且 BSD Now 条目标签实测为 “Former Co-Host”（同页 2.5 Admins 条目作 “Co-Host”，TechSNAP 亦作 “Former Co-Host”）——“前 512 期多数主持、其后交接、标为前任合主持人”三断言坐实。

title: 播客与提交权限的并行
issue: BSDCan 2017 讲者页（本人自述体）逐字：“became a FreeBSD docs committer in 2014, src committer in 2015, and was elected to the core team in 2016.”——doc 2014／src 2015／core 2016 三时点坐实。

title: ZFS 两书的合著
issue: 同页逐字：“In the spring of 2015, he published “FreeBSD Mastery: ZFS” with Michael W. Lucas, followed by “FreeBSD Mastery: Advanced ZFS” in 2016.”；本人站出版表同证（“FreeBSD Mastery: ZFS／with Michael W. Lucas／Tilted Windmill Press • 2015”与 “FreeBSD Mastery: Advanced ZFS／…• 2016”）——两源并证。

title: bhyve 的早期使用与会议报告
issue: bhyvecon 讲稿《Depenguinating Your Infrastructure》（署名 “Allan Jude -- ScaleEngine Inc.”）逐字：“One of the first users of bhyve”，并列运维经验（借双 E5 硬件予 Peter 与 Neel 开发新特性、Puppet recipe、性能实测）——“早期使用者、运维经验见于 bhyvecon 报告”成立。

title: 编辑委员会的跨机构组成
issue: 创刊公告（2014-02-10）逐字：“The Journal is guided by an editorial board made up of people from across the FreeBSD community, including, John Baldwin, … Marshall Kirk McKusick, George Neville-Neil, Hiroki Sato, and Robert Watson. The editorial board is responsible for the acquisition and vetting of content for the magazine.”；2016 年版权页逐人标题证三类混编（Baldwin “Member of the FreeBSD Core Team and Co-Chair of FreeBSD Journal Editorial Board”；Lucas “Author of Absolute FreeBSD”；Gibbs／Lavigne／Maste／Neville-Neil／Sato／Reuschling／Watson 等作 “Director of the FreeBSD Foundation”）——“稿件取舍权分散”系编委会集体职能表述，成立。

title: 专职编辑与作者协作
issue: 创刊公告逐字：“The editor is Jim Maurer who is the person with whom our authors work most closely getting their pieces into shape for publishing.”；2016 年版权页作 “James Maurer”（列于 Editor-at-Large 职）——设编辑一人、与作者协作打磨坐实。小注：“专职”宜解为“专任一职”，原文未言雇佣形态（full-time）。

title: 双月刊的发刊节奏
issue: 2016 年版权页逐字：“FreeBSD Journal (ISBN: 978-0-615-88479-0) is published 6 times a year (January/February, March/April, May/June, July/August, September/October, November/December).”；创刊公告同证（“The magazine will publish six issues per year.”）。重要时段注记：基金会期刊页 2026 年编辑年历已按季排四期（“Issue#73 Production Deployments — July-August-September 2026 — due July 31, 2026”）——“双月刊”仅适用于既往时段，正文须注明，勿与现行季刊形态相混。

title: 出版事务的外包安排
issue: 2016 年版权页逐字：“Published by the FreeBSD Foundation, 5757 Central Ave., Suite 201, Boulder, CO 80301”与 “S&W PUBLISHING LLC P O B O X 408, BELFAST, MAINE 04915”，其下列 Publisher／Editor-at-Large／Copy Editor／Art Director／Office Administrator／Advertising Sales 等承制职务——制作发行事务归 S&W、发行人为 FreeBSD Foundation 坐实。

title: 订阅与广告的收入结构
issue: 创刊公告逐字：“The FreeBSD Journal is financially supported by the FreeBSD Foundation, the 501(c)3 charitable organization whose sole purpose is to help the FreeBSD Project grow and flourish. Your subscriptions and the advertising revenue the Journal receives help to offset the money the Foundation needs to put in to support the Journal.”——订阅＋广告抵消基金会投入坐实。小注：“长期依赖母体补贴”系该创刊时点（2014-02）表述的延伸概括，正文宜注明出处时点。

title: 付费订阅到免费发行
issue: 2019 年第一季度报告导语逐字：“the FreeBSD Journal is now free to everyone”；基金会期刊页现行文逐字：“The FreeBSD Journal is a free publication. Read more in the FAQ about our reasons for moving to a free subscription model.”；创刊公告证初期订阅制（“You can find out how to subscribe to the Journal by going to www.freebsdjournal.com.”）——先付费订阅、2019 年起转免费、于基金会网站刊布三断言成立。

title: 站点账号的审批与分组
issue: Wiki/About 页逐字：“Decide on an AccountName (username, FirstnameLastname preferred) and Email Address for your new account and email them to wiki-admin@FreeBSD.org. WikiAdmin will create an account for you and send you an email.”与 “WikiAdmin will add you to ContributorsGroup.”——管理员人工开设并分组坐实；committers-guide 旁证账号获取路径（“Those who do not yet have an account can follow instructions on the Wiki/About page to obtain one.”）。

title: 编辑权限的两层划分
issue: About 页逐字：“ContributorsGroup provides write access to most pages, except for a few important pages, such as the FrontPage, cannot edit Group pages, nor add #acl keywords.”与 “DevelopersGroup provides access to most/all pages, except for those pages with more restrictive / additional ACLs, and can add #acl keywords.”——两层划分与“开发者组另可改访问控制（#acl）”坐实。精度注记：“首页等要害页面对两组均封闭”之“均”字未获逐字——原文仅明言 FrontPage 对贡献者组排除，开发者组侧只言受更严 ACL 约束，正文宜照原文限缩。

title: 百科条目的来源限定
issue: 维基百科《No original research》方针页逐字：“Wikipedia articles must not contain original research.”与 “The definition of original research includes any analysis or synthesis of published material that reaches or implies a conclusion not stated by the sources.”，页首并载 “editors must base their contributions on reliable, published sources, not their own original research.”——已刊布来源为准、禁推断综合成文坐实。

title: 无可靠来源则不成条
issue: 同方针页逐字：“If no reliable independent sources can be found on a topic, Wikipedia should not have an article about it.”——立条门槛逐字吻合。

title: 声望分层与答案排序
issue: SE 帮助页逐字：“Reputation is a rough measurement of how much the community trusts you; it is earned by convincing your peers that you know what you're talking about.”；导览页逐字：“Good answers are voted up and rise to the top. The best answers show up first so that they are always easy to find. The person who asked can mark one answer as “accepted”.”——声望记信任度、投票决定次序坐实。小注：原文并明言 “Accepting doesn't mean it's the best answer”，采纳置顶细节未显式，正文表述宜按导览页措辞。

title: 站内记录与正式文档的界线
issue: committers-guide 第 7.1 节逐字：“A wiki account allows sharing projects and ideas.”——“维基账号用于共享项目与想法”官方定位坐实。小注：后半“草稿与想法留在站内”为边界性概括，原文无此句，正文以此为限即可（账号获取并引 “Those who do not yet have an account can follow instructions on the Wiki/About page to obtain one.”）。

title: 取证范围覆盖双方全体
issue: 麦氏《Twenty Years of Berkeley Unix》逐字：“All the members of the CSRG were deposed as were nearly everyone employed at BSDI.”——“CSRG 全体＋BSDi 几乎全部雇员被取证”逐字落实。

title: 诉讼文书的撰写负担
issue: 同页逐字：“Keith Bostic and I personally had to write several hundred pages of material that found their way into various briefs.”——技术核心成员亲撰数百页材料进入诉讼文书成立。

title: 双方律师的文书往复
issue: 同页逐字：“Briefs, counter-briefs, and counter-counter-briefs flew back and forth between the lawyers.”——文书攻防有据；“律师主导程序节奏”系对同段听证、陈述与裁定过程的概括释义。

title: 禁令裁定的篇幅与时点
issue: 逐字：“In December 1992, Dickinson R. Debevoise, a United States District Judge in New Jersey, heard the arguments for the injunction.”；约六周后“he issued a forty-page opinion in which he denied the injunction and threw out all but two of the complaints.”——四十页意见、驳回禁令、仅留两项诉因全落实（裁定人为新泽西联邦地区法官 Debevoise）；题尾“裁定篇幅构成后续谈判文本基础”为叙事引申，一手无此断言。

title: 和解条款的文件计数
issue: 逐字：“three files were removed from the 18,000 that made up Networking Release 2, and a number of minor changes were made to other files”；另有“In addition, the University agreed to add USL copyrights to about 70 files”——删除三文件、改动若干文件逐字落实。

title: 和解对后续发行的约束
issue: 逐字：“The lawsuit settlement also stipulated that USL would not sue any organization using 4.4BSD-Lite as the base for their system. So, all the BSD groups that were doing releases at that time, BSDI, NetBSD, and FreeBSD, had to restart their code base with the 4.4BSD-Lite sources”——题面“三个分支”与一手所列 BSDI、NetBSD、FreeBSD 对应。

title: 免税地位与法务支出
issue: 基金会官网逐字：“The FreeBSD Foundation is a US-based 501(c)(3) non-profit organization”；2025 年度预算 PDF 支出栏明列“Legal Fees $10,000.00 $5,000.00 $15,000.00”——免税身份与法务常规支出科目两断言均落实。

title: 商标注册与使用许可
issue: 商标条款页明载 FreeBSD 标识“currently registered and/or otherwise being used in the United States and other countries”，并逐字要求“if you intend to sell items bearing the FreeBSD Marks, you must also get advance written permission from the Foundation for the specific item that you wish to sell.”——注册商标与周边制品逐件申请成立。

title: 跨境法人的注册地选择
issue: 双一手对照：FreeBSD 基金会“US-based 501(c)(3) non-profit organization”；OpenBSD 基金会官网逐字：“The OpenBSD Foundation is a Canadian not-for-profit corporation which exists to support OpenBSD and related projects such as OpenSSH”——美 501(c)(3) 与加拿大非营利法人并置成立。

title: 捐赠受理与用途限定
issue: 捐赠页逐字列用途：“We fund and manage projects, sponsor FreeBSD events, Developer Summits and provide travel grants”“We provide and help maintain computers and equipment”“represent the Project in executing contracts, license agreements, copyrights, trademarks, and other legal arrangements”——项目、会议活动、设备、法务四类落实；惟一手系陈述式例举（“such as”），未称穷尽，题面“被限定”宜软化为“主要用于”。

title: 年度预算与筹款目标
issue: 2025 年度预算 PDF 标题“2025 Budget Approved”、落款“Approved June 10, 2025”，收入目标公开“Donations/Funding 2,100,000.00”，支出全科目（含 Legal Fees）逐项列示；捐赠页设“Fundraising Campaign”节面向捐赠人——按年编制预算并公布筹款与支出目标成立。

title: 项目官员与承包监督
issue: 逐字：“Duane Adams, Berkeley’s contract monitor at DARPA, formed a group known as the ‘steering committee’ to help guide the design work and ensure that the research community’s needs were addressed.”——承包监督一职与组建指导委员会逐字落实；“把研究需求转成合同条款”为释义。

title: 首份合同的期限与目标
issue: 逐字：“Bob Fabry was able to get an 18-month contract with DARPA beginning in April 1980. This contract was to add features needed by the DARPA contractors.”——十八个月期限与为 DARPA 社区补足功能逐字落实。

title: 续约资金与学科分摊
issue: 逐字：“a new two-year contract was granted to Berkeley with funding almost five times that of the original. Half of the money went to the Unix project, the rest to other researchers in the Computer Science department.”——约五倍续约与对半分流逐字落实。

title: 指导委员会的席位分配
issue: 委员会名单逐字在案（BBN 之 Nemeth 与 Gurwitz、Bell 实验室之 Ritchie、Stanford 之 Lantz、CMU 之 Rashid、MIT 之 Halstead、ISI 之 Lynch、DARPA 之 Adams 与 Baker、UCLA 之 Popek、伯克利之 Fabry、Joy、Leffler）——承包方、军方、高校席位齐备；“厂商”对应 BBN 与 Bell 实验室等行业代表属归类引申（名单中无计算机制造商），“议程由资助方与承包方共同设定”亦为释义。

title: 承包商争议的裁定权
issue: 逐字：“DARPA decided that releasing two code bases would lead to unnecessary interoperability problems, and that just one implementation should be released”“The final decision by DARPA was that 4.3BSD would stick with the Berkeley code base.”——两份 TCP/IP 实现之争由资助方裁定、只发一套代码逐字落实。

title: 军方合同与安全项目的接续
issue: Watson 论文致谢逐字：“This research was supported under DARPA/SPAWAR contract N66001-01-C-8035 (‘CBOSS’).”（合同号含 2001 财年）；FreeBSD 架构手册逐字：“under DARPA/SPAWAR contract N66001-01-C-8035 (‘CBOSS’), as part of the DARPA CHATS research program.”——2001 年起安全框架由军方研究合同支撑成立；“资助线从操作系统研究转向安全研究”为宏观概括。

title: 院系资源的合流使用
issue: 同 3.3.3 逐字源：“Half of the money went to the Unix project, the rest to other researchers in the Computer Science department.”——与 V54.3.3.3 内容重复，正文宜分工（本节写院系制度面、彼节写经费面）。

title: UVM 替换 BSD VM 的落地
issue: NetBSD 1.4 官方公告逐字：“A new, totally rewritten virtual memory subsystem, UVM, created by Chuck Cranor, which is substantially cleaner and better performing than the old Mach derived VM subsystem.”——1.4 整体替换成立；惟一手称旧实现为“Mach derived”（该 VM 系经 4.4BSD 传入的 Mach 衍生实现），题面“旧的 BSD 虚拟机实现”宜注 Mach 来源。

title: 源码分发的千元收费
issue: Net-1 段逐字：“Although Berkeley charged a $1,000 fee to get a tape, anyone was free to get a copy from anyone who already had received it”并称“the CSRG was pleased that several hundred organizations purchased copies”；Net-2 段“several hundred individuals and organizations paid the $1,000 fee to get the distribution from Berkeley”——千元收费与数百机构个人付费逐字落实。

title: 教职与承包人的双重身份
issue: 逐字：“Professor Bob Fabry, of the University of California at Berkeley”“Bob Fabry was able to get an 18-month contract with DARPA beginning in April 1980”“Bob Fabry sets up an organization which was christened the Computer Systems Research Group, or CSRG for short.”——教授与合同承包人双重身份有据；题尾“制度支撑”为释义。

title: 跨国校际的长期协作
issue: 佐藤広生自述文（《FreeBSD in Japan》，FreeBSD Journal 2023 年 5／6 月号）作者简介逐字：“HIROKI SATO is an assistant professor at Tokyo Institute of Technology”“He was one of the FreeBSD core team members from 2006 to 2022, has been a FreeBSD Foundation board member since 2008, and has hosted AsiaBSDCon, an international conference on BSD-derived operating systems in Asia, since 2007.”；AsiaBSDCon 2019 官网“General Chair: Hiroki Sato (FreeBSD Project, Tokyo Institute of Technology)”、会址“March 21-24, 2019, Tokyo University of Science”——日本高校教职长期承担核心团队与年会主办两断言逐字落实。

title: 工作组议题的五项扩展
issue: P1003.1e/D17 草案正文逐字：“This standard, P1003.1e/D17: October 1997 (POSIX.1e), defines five independent, optional sets of interfaces”并列“(1) Access Control Lists (ACL) (2) Security Auditing (3) Capability (4) Mandatory Access Controls (MAC) (5) Information Labeling (IL)”，且“It is an extension to IEEE Std 1003.1-1990.”——五项扩展与“POSIX.1 之上”逐字落实。

title: 草案赞助的撤回时点
issue: PASC 标准报告（Stoughton“The Future of POSIX”专栏）逐字：“This year, we have withdrawn sponsorship for POSIX.1e and POSIX.2c (security)”——两项草案 1998 年内撤回赞助（该报告成文于 1998 年 7 月会议后，“初”字所指会议一手未载，正文宜写“1998 年”）；“止于第 17 稿”由两份 D17（October 1997）档面均标“WITHDRAWN”支撑。

title: 草案文本在实现中的存留
issue: Linux acl(5) 逐字：“While the work on 1003.1e has been abandoned, many UNIX style systems implement parts of POSIX.1e draft 17, or of earlier drafts.”；FreeBSD acl(3) 逐字：“FreeBSD supports POSIX.1e and NFSv4 ACLs”——标准未成文而接口随实现扩散成立。

title: 项目负责人与条款的对接
issue: Watson 自述页逐字：“I founded the TrustedBSD Project (1999) and OpenBSM Project (2005), which provide trusted operating system and audit extensions on the FreeBSD platform. Significant results of this work have now been integrated into the FreeBSD, NetBSD, OpenBSD, Linux, and Mac OS X operating systems”——由单一项目负责人（Watson）牵头把草案条款落成可运行代码成立；实际实现为团队协作（MAC 框架论文有合著者），正文宜写“牵头”。

title: 跨平台实现的分歧
issue: Linux acl(5) 逐字：“many UNIX style systems implement parts of POSIX.1e draft 17, or of earlier drafts”，并自述“The implementation is fully compliant with POSIX.1e draft 17; extensions are marked as such.”——各家实现面与稿次不一、同一接口跨系统不等价成立。

title: 人物条目的编年依据
issue: 断言“Amdahl 于 1960 年代主持 System/360 设计”获 IBM 官方史页逐字坐实：“The System/360’s chief architect was Gene Amdahl, who also designed the IBM 704, a mainframe primarily used in scientific research.”；同页“Launched on April 7, 1964…”证项目发布在 1960 年代。CHM 展页另有“In 1960, IBM’s Gene Amdahl was named manager of architecture for their new System/360 family of mainframe computers.”——正文若需系年可用“1960 年出任架构经理”。

title: 接点判定的引证要求
issue: 方法纪律题（接点须落到可引的已刊来源，传闻与类推不作依据），无外部事实断言；与卷头名录化口径及 4.1.5 收录门槛配套，属体例自陈。

title: 距离感与叙事增益
issue: 方法纪律题（无直接往来人物只作技术前提交代、距离须说明），无外部事实断言；与 4.4／4.5 收录 Licklider、McCarthy 等人的体例理由互为表里。

title: 人物条的行动与位置取材
issue: 取材口径题（以职务、机型与机构位置立题，生卒年表只作背景），无外部事实断言；4.2–4.3 节人物条均按此取材，属体例自陈。

title: 名录化收录的边界
issue: 收录门槛题（以独立可靠来源为门槛、不以知名度定去留），无外部事实断言；与卷头“名录化口径与考据纪律单列”及 4.6 节处置办法衔接。

title: 兼容机与指令集的复用
issue: IBM 官方史册《The 360 Revolution》逐字坐实插接兼容路线：“Gene Amdahl, an IBM engineer who helped develop the System/360 architecture, started the Amdahl Corporation, the first of several companies in the United States, Japan, and Western Europe that began marketing 360 — and later 370 — compatible processors.”；同册另见“Many of the plug-compatible storage and peripheral devices still needed to be invented.”——“插接兼容”一词在一手内先用于存储与外设，正文宜分清“兼容处理器”与“插接兼容外设”两个层次。

title: VAX 架构对内核的绑定
issue: McKusick《Twenty Years of Berkeley Unix》坐实内存管理的 VAX 出身与换血时点：Berkeley VM 系 Babaoglu“implementing a working set paging system on the VAX”；VAX 专属 VM 的替代品迟至 4.3BSD-Reno（1990 年初）方至——“incorporate the virtual memory system from the MACH operating system done at Carnegie-Mellon University”；另见“it was becoming increasingly obvious that the VAX architecture was reaching the end of its life…”。注：“紧绑”系压缩表述——一手证 VM 始于 VAX 实作且 4.4 前未换架，未用“tied”字样；内核拆分见 4.2.5。

title: 《人月神话》在 FreeBSD 刊物上的评介
issue: FreeBSD 基金会官方刊物 PDF 逐字坐实：页眉“38 FreeBSD Journal by John Baldwin”，正题“The Mythical Man-Month and Its Relevance to the FreeBSD Project”，期号“Nov/Dec 2016 39”；文末简介“JOHN BALDWIN (jhb@freebsd.org) joined the FreeBSD Project as a committer in 1999.”。“其方法论被移用于 FreeBSD”为评介通篇主旨（以 FreeBSD 发行节奏、kyua 测试、Doxygen 文档对读 Brooks 各章），非夸饰。注：评介对象系 1995 年周年纪念版。

title: 系统架构师的共同出身
issue: IBM 官方史页逐字：“The System/360’s chief architect was Gene Amdahl, who also designed the IBM 704, a mainframe primarily used in scientific research.”与“Project leader Fred Brooks, who coined the term ‘computer architecture,’ collaborated with Bob Evans and Erich Bloch…”——同一机型的架构负责人与项目负责人两职分立坐实。“后来分途”一侧（Amdahl 离职创办同名公司售兼容机）见 4.2.1 所引 IBM 史册；Brooks 去向（转赴 UNC）本批未另取证，正文落笔时补。

title: 机器相关代码的分离
issue: McKusick 逐字坐实：“…enabled us to finish the work, started by Bill Joy, of splitting the BSD kernel into machine-dependent and machine-independent parts. The result of this work was released as 4.3BSD-Tahoe in June 1988.”且“the work done to split the kernel into machine-independent and machine-dependent parts proved to be extremely valuable as BSD was ported to numerous other architectures.”；始作另有“…reorganizing the Unix kernel sources to isolate machine dependencies.”（Joy，1982 年夏）。“为跨机型发行”的目的句由此支撑。

title: 工作站厂商对 UNIX 的采用
issue: SPARC Product Directory 系史页逐字：“For vendors, the simplicity of licensing and porting Unix onto their own hardware gave many small computer companies the ability to offer serious competitive alternatives to the low and mid range computers being sold by their much larger competitors on proprietary platforms.”；具体实例“In 1987 Sun had already achieved a leading position in the Unix workstation market with its two product lines based on Motorola 68020, and Intel 386 processor technology.”。注：系 B 级二手（业界目录衍文），正文宜再补一层厂商年表或 Salus。

title: 网络文件系统的接口扩散
issue: RFC 1094（Sun，1989-03）逐字：“The Sun Network Filesystem (NFS) protocol provides transparent remote access to shared files across networks. The NFS protocol is designed to be portable across different machines, operating systems, network architectures, and transport protocols.”与“Implementations already exist for a variety of machines, from personal computers to supercomputers.”——跨系统共享与业界铺开坐实；CSRG 亦采“a Sun-compatible version of the Network Filesystem (NFS)”（McKusick），BSD 侧采用再添一层。

title: 精简指令集的率先采用
issue: “率先”（业界第一）不获一手支撑：ETHW（IEEE 里程碑，2015 年落成）只作“Sun Microsystems introduced SPARC (Scalable Processor Architecture) RISC (Reduced Instruction-Set Computing) in 1987.”，并把 SPARC 与“MIPS, POWER, PA-RISC”并列为同期 RISC 架构；SPARC Product Directory 系史页明言“At that time most computer manufacturers were talking about introducing their own RISC based computers.”。一手可证者为“1987. Sun introduced the the first SPARC based computer the Sun-4.”（首款 SPARC 机，非业界首款 RISC 机；句中“the the”系原件排印）与“within a few years, Sun was to drop both Intel and Motorola platforms and migrate its entire customer base to SPARC.”（全产品线迁移为数年过程，非 1987 年一步到位）。〔已采纳落账 2026-11-01〕〔B2/D3 适配后定题：SPARC 架构随 Sun-4 入线（1987）〕
suggested_title: 1987 年 Sun-4：自研 RISC 架构（SPARC）进入 Sun 产品线

title: 工程师主导的技术扩散
issue: 概括题以两项可核实例落锚：NFS 跨业界实现（RFC 1094：“Implementations already exist for a variety of machines, from personal computers to supercomputers.”）；SPARC 技术授权开放（“Sun’s policy of licensing technology and encouraging other oem’s to use Sun developed interfaces…”）。注：题面无具体人名年份可驳，“工程师主导”主体（Bechtolsheim 等）须在正文逐项落锚。

title: 开放系统口径与标准
issue: 断言为史学概括（“开放系统”作为厂商营销口径与竞争话术），本批未检得直接一手：SPARC Product Directory 系史页只有用户侧表述“users were starting to appreciate that open systems standards which were supported by many manufacturers helped increase choice and performance while at the same time keeping a lid on costs.”（标准作为买方取向），非厂商营销话术侧；已查该页与 RFC 1094，均无营销口径句。正文落笔须引具体厂商实例（如 DEC／HP／Sun 的 open systems 广告或年报口径），未获不编造。

title: 共生构想的技术前提
issue: Licklider《Man-Computer Symbiosis》（IRE Transactions on Human Factors in Electronics，HFE-1，1960-03，pp. 4–11）原句逐字：“Man-computer symbiosis is an expected development in cooperative interaction between men and electronic computers.”——“可预期的发展”与“协同交互”两要素同出题面所指文本。

title: 紧密耦合的设想与边界
issue: 同文逐字坐实两层：远景——“The hope is that, in not too many years, human brains and computing machines will be coupled together very tightly”；能力不足之承认——“Any present-day large-scale computer is too fast and too costly for real-time cooperative thinking with one man.”（另列内存与显示诸限）。

title: 学科命名的会议方案
issue: 提案原件（McCarthy 个人页藏本，全文取回）逐字：标题“A PROPOSAL FOR THE DARTMOUTH SUMMER RESEARCH PROJECT ON ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE”；“We propose that a 2 month, 10 man study of artificial intelligence be carried out during the summer of 1956 at Dartmouth College in Hanover, New Hampshire.”——“人工智能”入正式提案坐实。注：提案落款“August 31, 1955”，系为 1956 年暑期研究而写，正文宜两时点并陈。

title: 模拟智能的可行边界
issue: 提案逐字：“The study is to proceed on the basis of the conjecture that every aspect of learning or any other feature of intelligence can in principle be so precisely described that a machine can be made to simulate it.”——“精确描述从而可由机器模拟”的假设逐字成立。

title: DARPA 指导委员会中的高校席位
issue: McKusick 逐字坐实名单（斯坦福 Keith Lantz、CMU Rick Rashid、MIT Bert Halstead、UCLA Jerry Popek 均在列）：“Duane Adams, Berkeley’s contract monitor at DARPA, formed a group known as the ‘steering committee’…It included Bob Fabry, Bill Joy, and Sam Leffler of the University of California at Berkeley; Alan Nemeth and Rob Gurwitz of Bolt, Beranek, and Newman; Dennis Ritchie of Bell Laboratories; Keith Lantz of Stanford University; Rick Rashid of Carnegie-Mellon University; Bert Halstead of the Massachusetts Institute of Technology; Dan Lynch of The Information Sciences Institute; Duane Adams and Bob Baker of DARPA; and Jerry Popek of the University of California at Los Angeles.”。注：该委员会系 4.2BSD 设计指导委员会（1981-04 至 1983-06，每半年一会），“厂商实验室”落点为 Bell Labs（AT&T）与 BBN；正文须注明系 Unix 设计面委员会，非 AI 专项。

title: 机构席位与个人影响
issue: 方法题（席位按机构派出、人物条另找私人材料补个人行动），无独立事实断言；上题名单确按“人名＋所属机构”逐人列名，可作正文旁证，“另找私人材料”属体例要求。

title: 提案文本的自陈体例
issue: 提案逐字：“In addition to the above collectively formulated problems for study, we have asked the individuals taking part to describe what they will work on. Statements by the four originators of the project are attached.”；附件确为第一人称自陈（Shannon 篇开篇“I would like to devote my research to one or both of the topics listed below. While I hope to do so…”）——本人陈述写成、可引一手成立。

title: 发起人名单的列名方式

title: 分支间代码移用的惯例
issue: 断言三件：跨分支移用为惯例、原作者与移植者分列、署名随代码进入新分支。官方 Committer's Guide 逐字：“The project makes extensive use of `git cherry-pick -x` with all lines preserved”“Clearly mark direct commits distinct from commits that land a change from another branch”“Use the `-x` flag with `git cherry-pick`. This adds a line to the commit message that includes the hash of the original commit when merging.”；官方提交模板钩子列“Obtained from:”字段并注明“The commit author should be set appropriately, using `git commit --author` if someone besides the committer sent in the change.”——原作者与提交者分列、原始哈希随落地进入新分支，题面成立。

title: 一人多项目参与的可核记录
issue: DragonFly 官方 team 页逐字：“Matt has also contributed code to The FreeBSD Project and the Linux kernel for subsystems such as VM and NFS.”——成员页明载 Dillon 向 FreeBSD 与 Linux 内核提交代码；同页按真名加账号前缀列成员，跨项目身份可比对，题面成立。

title: 会议场合的跨分支协调
issue: AsiaBSDCon 2011 官方页程序委员会逐字列“Mark T. Uemura (OpenBSD Support Japan, Inc.)”“Hidetoshi Shimokawa (FreeBSD Project)”“Masao Uebayashi (The NetBSD Foundation)”，另有主席 Hiroki Sato（FreeBSD）——三系同席，题面前半成立；“跨分支事务在会期当面议定”为叙事推论，正文宜标注系解读。

title: 提交权限的分项授予
issue: Committer's Guide“Commit Bit Types”节逐字：“When FreeBSD commit bits are allocated, the areas of the tree where the bit may be used are specified.”并分列 src、doc、ports 三型；René Ladan 自述逐字：“I started contributing to the (now defunct) Dutch translation of the FreeBSD Handbook and was consequently rewarded with a doc commit bit in 2008. I made the same mistake with ports land and was faced with a ports commit bit in 2010.”——文档与 Port 分两次授予、权限按子树，题面成立。

title: 跨分支共享项目的法人归属
issue: OpenBSD Foundation 官方页逐字：“a Canadian not-for-profit corporation which exists to support OpenBSD and related projects”，其项目列表含 OpenSSH、OpenBGPD、OpenNTPD、OpenSMTPD、LibreSSL、mandoc、rpki-client——共享项目由 OpenBSD 一侧基金会统一支持，题面成立。

title: 城市用户组的例会制度
issue: FreeBSD Journal 2016 年 11／12 月刊逐字：“User groups are one of the foundations of open-source projects. Through meetings, talks, and local conferences, they bring new people into contact with others who work on the same software.”；NYC*BUG 页载“With our standard meeting time of 18:45”并逐月列活动——例会制与新人入口两点有支撑；“第一道门”系叙事性引申，正文宜作表述处理。

title: 地区年会与全球议程的对接
issue: BSD Taiwan 许立文受访逐字：“2017 年的時候，想說要為 AsiaBSDCon 換地點做準備，便試著辦了一個台灣的地區性年會，沒想到辦完之後是有盈餘的，就把經費拿來繼續辦活動，一兩個月會有聚會。”——自办、盈余续办、对 AsiaBSDCon 的层级对接三点逐字坐实；属当事人口述（单源），正文宜注明口述性质。

title: 跨语种宣传与投稿联络
issue: 佐藤论文（FreeBSD Journal 2023 年 5／6 月刊）逐字：“Since communication in English was always challenging, the activities were often invisible from places where the official BSD projects run. Regarding FreeBSD, many people outside Japan have helped communicate by visiting Japan.”；另载 JFUG“actively worked on translating manual pages, the official website, and book-like documents”——语言隔阂致不可见与翻译转达两点一手坐实。

title: 联络人的更替与交接
issue: BSDCan 官方博客逐字：“I am delighted with what the volunteers have accomplished, and look forward to handing the 2026 con chair (Patrick McEvoy) a functional and financially sustainable conference.”；又“You gotta help run a BSDCan before we'll trust you to host a BSDCan.”——交接以能否接续办会为实标准坐实；“按年交接”与逐年 con chair 制度相合。

title: 会议赞助的基金会渠道
issue: FreeBSD Journal 2016 年 11／12 月刊理事会信逐字：“In 2016 we have sponsored BSD conferences, including AsiaBSDCon, BSDCan, and EuroBSD, and we have undertaken significant outreach at non-BSD events so that we not only reach people who already know about FreeBSD, but also those who should know more about FreeBSD.”——2016 年赞助三会与非 BSD 活动外联，题面成立（原文缩写作 EuroBSD，即 EuroBSDCon）。

title: 厂商招募与提交者的流向
issue: FreeBSD News Flash 1999 页（usenet-fr 镜像）逐字：“08-Sep-1999 New committers: Boris Popov (Netware) and Wilfredo Sanchez (FreeBSD/Apple Darwin collaboration)”——1999 年新提交者含 Netware 与 Apple Darwin 合作方，提交公告与厂商合作同条载明，题面成立；正文引用宜回指 freebsd.org 原页并注明镜像途径。

title: Apple 以 FreeBSD 为参考平台
issue: CNN／IDG 报道（1999-11-01，Vicki Brown）逐字：“Apple's core OS kernel team has chosen FreeBSD as its reference platform.”；同篇“Wilfredo Sanchez, technical lead for open source projects at Apple”讲 Darwin 项目——与 1999 年新闻页 Sanchez 的 FreeBSD/Apple Darwin committer 记录互证，两独立源，题面成立。

title: 跨系统项目的技术迁移
issue: BSDCan 2004 讲者页逐字：“Michael is the lead architect on the Linux FreeS/WAN project”（同页其讲 libpcap 1.0）；DragonFly 官方 team 页逐字：“Matt has also contributed code to The FreeBSD Project and the Linux kernel for subsystems such as VM and NFS.”——两栈人员与方案流动有实例；Richardson 的 BSD 侧身份归属，正文宜点名依据后再用“成员”一词。

title: 产业场景对议题的塑形
issue: BSDCan 2017 讲者页逐字：“Allan Jude is VP of Operations at ScaleEngine Inc. where he is in charge of managing the global network of servers, and more than 1000 terabytes of ZFS, that make up the ScaleEngine CDN.”——“千余 TB ZFS”逐字坐实（more than 1000 terabytes），产业场景进入会议议题成立。

title: 账号命名与实名偏好
issue: FreeBSD wiki About 页逐字：“Decide on an AccountName (username, FirstnameLastname preferred) and Email Address for your new account and email them to wiki-admin@FreeBSD.org.”——“名+姓”系 preferred（推荐）而非强制，题面成立。

title: 化名维护者的权责
issue: IRC/Nicknames 页表头逐字：“Nickname[,othernickname] | Network(s) | FreeBSD login | Name”——昵称与 FreeBSD login 并列登记；Wiki/About 页逐字：“WikiAdmin will add you to ContributorsGroup.”——权限系于账号而非化名，题面成立。

title: 匿名材料的不可核处
issue: IRC/Nicknames 页逐字：“Please don't add entries for other people unless they have explicitly asked you to.”——匿名者不可能入昵称表；后半“条目只能记其存在与渠道”系本卷处理方法，属体例层，与 6.1 节纪律一致。

title: 假名与实名的并存记录
issue: Committer's Guide“Steps for New Committers”逐字：“some people add entries to the How We Got Here, IRC Nicks, Dogs of FreeBSD, and or Cats of FreeBSD pages.”；IRC/Nicknames 页同页并载昵称、login 与真名（如“knu | EFnet / IRCnet | knu@ | AkinoriMusha”）——两套标识并行有官方依据，题面成立。

title: 基金会层面的参与通道
issue: FreeBSD Journal 2016 年刊编务页将 McKusick、Watson、Gibbs、Sato、Neville-Neil、Maste 等长期参与者并列于理事栏（Maste 系雇员“Director of Project Development, FreeBSD Foundation”，亦长期 committer）；ConferenceReports.pdf 逐字：“This non-stop attendance also drew the attention of the EuroBSDCon Foundation in 2016, which resulted in me being pulled over during dinner to join a board meeting the next day.”——出席者被吸纳入理事会，“人事结构本身构成进入通道”坐实。
